channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Middlebury's wastewater treatment plant is getting a major upgrade funded by a fifty million dollar bond. The project will fix outdated equipment and is expected to finish by twenty thirty-one. The plant serves thousands, including Middlebury College students and local businesses.

The North Country in New York will get eleven point six million dollars for road paving next year. Governor Kathy Hochul announced a hundred million dollars statewide for repaving projects. Two million dollars will resurface Interstate Eighty-Seven near Plattsburgh.

Addison County enjoyed a bountiful apple season this fall thanks to good weather. Local orchardists reported plentiful crops and appreciated community support. The season is now winding down or finished at many orchards.

Vermont business leaders told the Boston Fed about rising costs and budget-conscious customers. Killington Resort saw a six percent increase in ski visits but a drop in food sales. The resort has invested eighty million dollars in infrastructure upgrades over three years.
